status: FREEZE READINESS OPEN — C1 DENOMINATOR FRAGILITY

representativeness.estimand: representative eligible pre-37 cycle-membership directed-edge population
representativeness.selector: outcome-blind hash order over all eligible edges; U is not a ranking input
representativeness.consequence: A1 tests a representative eligible-edge effect. It does not test an effect among high-propensity or anomalous edges; that would require a different selector and a new target set before freeze.

freeze_decision.worth_freezing: NO — HOLD AS DRAFT UNTIL C4
freeze_decision.worth_freezing_reason: The target sets are compliant and representative; the blocker is the four-row C1 denominator, not the selected edges. Do not regenerate targets unless Path B is chosen.
freeze_decision.scope: the current six-seed target artifact and the current four-target A1 cell output
basis: The C6 prevalence proxy is adequate: 602/672 K and 586/672 Y_ind.
The C1 denominator is at most four target rows, so the 0.95 floor is a 100% rule (3/4 = 0.75).
All six seeds having all four K rows is 6.9% under independence; the design is fragile, not merely underpowered.
revisit_when: C4 non-target rows enlarge the C1 denominator and this review is rerun.
A larger target block or a redesigned selector is registered before freeze.

findings.finding: The 24 targets are statistically indistinguishable from the 358 unselected candidates on cycle-36 strength.
Cycle membership and positive U do not narrow the candidate universe; every candidate is eligible.
C6 supplies a high K/Y_ind denominator in its own world; this is a proxy, not target validation.
With four target rows, the 0.95 C1 floor is effectively 100% preservation; one lost row gives 0.75.
A0's hard-edge prevalence is low, but a random 24-target sample has a material chance of containing one.

decision.verdict: FREEZE READINESS OPEN — C1 DENOMINATOR FRAGILITY
decision.reading: P0 and feasibility pass, but four target rows per seed make the precommitted 0.95 C1 floor a 100% preservation rule. The prevalence proxy is adequate; the denominator is not. The current cell emits target rows only; C4 non-target rows are needed to give C1 a denominator larger than four. Do not freeze on the current target artifact.

freeze_question.question: Does a random eligible-edge design have enough expected measurable structure to justify freeze?
freeze_question.basis: K and Y_ind prevalence are high enough that missing structure is not the blocker. The blocker is C1: four rows make the 0.95 floor a 100% rule, and the all-six all-four-K proxy is 6.9% under independence. C4 rows or a larger N must change the denominator before freeze.
freeze_question.if_yes: Freeze the representative eligible-edge design after the manifest review.
freeze_question.if_no: Do not freeze; enlarge the C1 denominator with C4 rows or redesign the target block.

next: If Path A (representative eligible-edge effect) is retained: implement C4 non-target rows and enlarge the C1 denominator.
If Path B (high-carrier-propensity effect) is required: redesign the selector and regenerate targets before freeze; that is a different experiment.
Re-run this review against the larger denominator before any freeze decision.

not_evidence: A read-only power/prevalence review over different-seed C6 and A0 records. It runs no A1 cell, assigns no seed, freezes no target and establishes no causal, capability or transfer claim.
